title: Guitar and banjo with Kid Thomas; keeping the first instrument
summary: With Kid Thomas he played guitar and a little banjo; he got rid of both when he quit but kept the first one as a souvenir.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players
story.community_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section's changing role

blocks.x: When, when, you told me you played with Kit Thomas, when you played with Kit Thomas band, did you play guitar or banjo?
I played guitar with Kit Thomas. Not banjo?

I played a little banjo a while with Kit Thomas too. Well, when I decided to just quit, I just got rid of both of them. I got rid of the banjo and the guitar. I just kept this year on account of a souvenir. That was the first one I ever started fooling with, and I kept it just to keep it for a souvenir, round the house.

That box? I don't know how old it is. I know when I, when I got it, it was, I guess I was around about twenty years old or so when I got that banjo. It was down on Rampart Street, me and Red Allen had seen it in the showcase, and went in there and got it for five dollars. Well, he must have been a kid, huh?
